name: DS-77EX
description:
## Description

A speaker system developed as a next-generation speaker for Diatone.

WOOFER
A 32 cm cone type woofer using carbon graphite honeycomb cone is mounted in the low range.

The Carbon Graphite Honeycomb Cone is a honeycomb construction cone unique to Diatone. It satisfies the requirements for low-frequency units such as light mass, high rigidity, moderate internal loss, and large bending rigidity. The DS-77EX uses carbon graphite composite with high specific elastic modulus as a new skin material. Combined with the newly developed honeycomb core, it achieves low strain, low resonance, and excellent high-speed response.

For the DS-77EX, we pay attention to the frame structure and have developed and adopted a unique R. S. (High Rigid Support) frame.
The frame is a rigid 8-legged frame with alternating legs to reduce resonance and disperse resonance modes, thereby increasing the rigidity of the frame and magnetic circuit and reducing vibration of the magnetic circuit.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.

1000 filament carbon cloth cone is used for the diaphragm.
This diaphragm is made of 1000-filament carbon cloth, which is made from 10 carbon fiber filaments as one thread. This realizes a broadband unit that is light, highly elastic, excellent in damping characteristics, and low in natural sound.
In addition, the center cap has a specific elastic modulus approximately 40% higher than that of untreated titanium, and uses super ω-titanium, which is light in mass and hard, to improve the characteristics of the high-frequency part.

High-precision tangential edge is used for the edge part.
The edge is made of a laminated cloth consisting of two sheets of cloth coated with damping material, which improves the rise of the sound and reduces the squeal in the mid-range.

The frame part uses the R. S. frame as well as the woofer.

TWEETER
A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.

The diaphragm material uses super ω-titanium, which has undergone a special surface hardening treatment in addition to ω-titanium.
Super ω-titanium has more than 40% higher specific elastic modulus than untreated titanium, greatly expanding the regeneration bandwidth. The film also forms a three layer structure with different physical properties in the diaphragm structure, reducing the noise that is often seen in metal diaphragms.
In addition, the DS-77EX employs a D. U. D. structure in which the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated to eliminate high resonance frequencies outside the audible band. In addition, the DS-77EX eliminates energy loss at the bonded part and transmits the driving force generated in the voice coil without loss, greatly improving response to input signals.

The D. M. system is adopted for the frame structure, and high rigidity is achieved by the monocoque structure in which the magnetic circuit is framed.

NETWORK
OFC with low DC resistance is used for all connections in the network section. In addition, a crimping wiring method is adopted in which wires are passed through a sleeve and the sleeve is crimped. This reduces distortion at the interface caused by dissimilar metals.

The wiring after the input terminal is completely independent between each unit, eliminating interference between each unit and network.
Since the Woofer coil generates a particularly large magnetic flux, the coil is divided into two sections to eliminate intermodulation.

CABINET
ENCLOSURE
A 4-side round baffle structure has been adopted for the front baffle of the enclosure, and the diffraction effect is suppressed by rounding the four sides of the top, bottom, left and right, and it improves the middle and high range.

The internal structure of the enclosure employs a highly rigid and distributed resonance structure that makes full use of modal analysis. By analyzing vibration modes from the entire structure and maintaining their balance, high-resolution reproduction is possible. It is made of carefully selected high-density chip board with high rigidity and low natural sound.

CABINET
The rigidity of the enclosure itself is increased for low frequency modes, and the dispersion resonance type structure unique to Diatone is used for medium and high frequency modes.

The DS-77EX comes in two color variations: dark brown and black.

name: M-T01
description:
## Description

"This is a compact cassette deck with various mechanisms.2-motor configuration and closed loop dual capstan system are adopted. In this method, the tape is held more securely by two pairs of pinch rollers and a capstan. When the motor rotates, the tape tension in the loop is always kept constant by the difference between the peripheral speeds of the flywheels on the take-up side and on the supply side, and the tape surface and the head are brought into close contact with each other with a stable force. In addition, the two capstan and pinch rollers can almost completely the rotation unevenness and vibration of the reel table, thereby achieving stable tape travel. In addition, the M-T01 uses a 2-motor type, and a PLL servo DC motor is installed in the constant speed motor to achieve excellent tape travel. The operation of the mechanism is controlled electronically, and the feather-touch operation is adopted in the tape control section, enabling direct change from any operation mode to the next operation without pressing the stop button.

HEADS
The head uses a newly developed magnetic Sendust head that combines the superior magnetic properties of permalloy with the ultra-long life of ferrite, enabling sound quality to be maintained as it is during initial adjustment for a long period of time. It is equipped with ASPS (Automatic Spacing Pause System) which automatically creates a non-recording area at a fixed interval on the tape during recording. If you press the ASPS button during recording, the ASPS lamp lights up and the tape continues to run while cutting the recording input signal. Approximately three seconds later, the deck automatically moves to a pause state, the ASPS lamp goes out, and the ASPS state changes to a PAUSE state. Equipped with a peak meter. Equipped with a 3-stage switching tape selector with independent bias and equalizer. It is equipped with Memory Stop and Memory Start yesterday. Equipped with an MPX filter that can be turned on / off. When used with an external audio timer, absence recording is possible. Microphone input and line input can be adjusted independently to enable microphone mixing.

NOISE REDUCTION
It has a built-in Dolby circuit. We have mono my Kujac on Lch."

name: DS-27B
description:
## Description

"This bookshelf type speaker system pursues 2-way sound quality.

WOOFER
A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The cone paper uses a double-layer cone. Using our unique technology, we have increased the strength without losing weight and expanded the piston motion band by creating a high-density molded structure with thickness only at the peripheral part. In addition, the center cap is made of a special aluminum alloy that is light and highly rigid to obtain a high-density mid-range. In addition, a damping ring made of special synthetic rubber is attached to the voice coil to function as a mechanical filter to improve the characteristics near the crossover frequency. A die-cast frame with sufficient thickness and structure is used for the frame, and resolution is improved by eliminating natural vibration.

TWEETER
A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range. The center cap is made of titanium, which is lightweight and hard, and provides more flat characteristics by suppressing split vibration in the high-frequency range. In addition, by increasing the volume of the chamber behind the diaphragm and setting the resonance frequency to 600 Hz, the directivity near the crossover frequency is improved. In addition, by installing a subframe with an orifice structure, the resonance is controlled and a bright high-frequency range is obtained. Solid die-cast frame is used for the frame. The voice coil of each unit is heat-resistant, so that it can withstand heat generated by Dainyu Chikara and improve input resistance.

NETWORK
In order to reduce distortion of network circuits, the characteristics of each element and the entire structure are examined. Capacitors and coils are designed with low distortion by minimizing AC and DC resistance. In addition, the use of lug plate terminals reduces DC resistance between elements due to wiring, eliminating distortion and coloring. The high-frequency range is equipped with a 2-position switching type level control. The front baffle has a symmetrical layout with a tweeter inside, which improves the orientation by improving the directivity of the high sound range.

ENCLOSURE
In order to increase the strength of the enclosure, the joint structure employs a strong sealing hozo joint, in which plates are connected so as to engage each other, and reinforcement is placed in the appropriate place to disperse the resonance mode and prevent the box rumbling phenomenon."

name: DS-32BMKII.
description:
## Description

"A bookshelf speaker system based on the DS-32B and incorporating new technologies such as the DUD structure.

WOOFER
A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The cone paper uses a peripheral reinforcement cone that is molded with high density by giving thickness only to the peripheral part. It increases the strength without losing the lightness, and suppresses non-axisymmetric division vibration and strain at large amplitude. The magnetic circuit uses a low-distortion magnetic circuit equipped with a special alloy FN ring to improve the non-linearity of magnetic characteristics that tends to occur in the air gap near the voice coil and to reduce distortion. A die-cast frame with sufficient thickness is used for the frame to suppress natural vibration.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. For the cone paper of the diaphragm, dry pre-cone is used to obtain appropriate hardness and internal loss. For the center cap, thin duralumin plate is molded and subjected to damping treatment to smooth out the characteristics of the high-frequency part. In addition, V-shaped fixed edge is used for the edge, and special damping material is applied. Thick diecasting is used for the frame.

TWEETER
A 4 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. In order to expand the dynamic range and reduce distortion, the DS-32BmkII uses the Diatone Unified Diaphragm (D. U. D.), which integrates the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin. This allows vibration to be transmitted directly to the diaphragm, thereby expanding the high-frequency limit. In addition, the heat radiation effect is enhanced and the transient response is improved.

NETWORK
The network section uses a low-strain network based on material considerations. In the DS-32BmkII, metalized tapered film capacitors with excellent high-frequency characteristics and low distortion are used as capacitors, and oxygen-free copper wires with low DC resistance are used for coils and wiring. It is equipped with a level control that can switch between 3 levels of middle and high range, and the characteristics can be adjusted according to the conditions of the listening room. The front baffle units are arranged in a row to take into account the directivity of the high-frequency range, and the sound image localization is improved by making the left and right speakers symmetrical.

ENCLOSURE
The enclosure has a bass reflex structure, and by adopting a folding port, radiation from the port to the mid-range is reduced. In addition, in order to increase the rigidity of the enclosure, baffle plates are joined by a method called wrapping and retaining hozo joining, and box ringing is suppressed by distributing resonance modes by placing reinforcing members in appropriate positions."

description:
## Description

"A bookshelf type speaker system with a 2-way D. U. D structure for the first time.

WOOFER
A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. This unit uses a high-density molded cone diaphragm with a thicker periphery and a new corrugation shape, and a thick aluminum die-cast frame to eliminate resonance.

TWEETER
A 5 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. This tweeter uses D. U. D. (DIATONE Unified Diaphargm). By molding the outer periphery of the diaphragm into a cylindrical shape and integrating it with the voice coil bobbin, rigidity reduction due to adhesion is suppressed, and high-resonance frequencies are expelled out of the audible band. In addition, response to input signals is greatly improved due to low attenuation in the high-frequency range. In addition, by transmitting heat from the voice coil directly to the diaphragm, resistance to input is improved by preventing increase in conductor resistance of the voice coil due to temperature rise. The tweeter used in the DS-33D is designed for 2-way use with a large back cavity to lower the fo. In addition, the damper is also improved. This realizes playback sound with excellent transient characteristics and improves the quality especially in the mid - and high-frequency range. In addition, aluminum die-cast frame with sufficient thickness and strong structure is used for the frame to suppress natural vibration of the frame itself.

NETWORK
OFC (oxygen-free copper wire) with low DC resistance is used for the coil and wiring material of the network section, and DC resistance between elements due to wiring is reduced by adopting lug terminal board. It is equipped with 3-position switching type level control for high frequency. The unit layout of the front baffle is symmetrical with a tweeter inside to improve the directivity of the high-frequency range. In addition, an elbow structure pipe is adopted for the bass reflex duct to reduce radiation in the mid-frequency range.

ENCLOSURE
The enclosure is designed using Diatone's unique vibration analysis technology, and has a highly rigid distributed resonance structure. The joint structure uses strong encasing and hozo joints that mesh plates together. In addition, reinforcing materials are placed in appropriate places to disperse resonance modes and prevent box ringing."

name: DS-37B
description:
## Description

"This is a bookshelf speaker system developed using Diatone's unique technology such as the DUD structure.

WOOFER
A 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. A new type of pre-cone has been developed and used for the diaphragm. This cone paper has been specially molded to increase the thickness of the peripheral part and to increase the density. It increases the strength without losing its lightness and expands the piston motion band. In addition, a low-distortion magnetic circuit is adopted for the magnetic circuit to reduce the distortion generated from the drive system. In the low-distortion magnetic circuit, a special nickel-based alloy developed from a metallurgical engineering approach is mounted on the surface of magnetic materials such as pole pieces to improve the non-uniformity of magnetic flux distribution and to propose distortion. The frame uses die-cast frame to reduce resonance.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. The cone paper is made from the well-known dry prescone. In addition, the center cap made from thin duralumin sheet and subjected to appropriate damping treatment, and the Cross Edge coated with special damping material are used to suppress singing in the middle and high frequency range.

TWEETER
A 4 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. The diaphragm is made of titanium alloy with high hardness and light mass, and a clear high sound range is obtained by suppressing split vibration. In addition, a DUD structure in which the diaphragm and the voice coil bobbin are integrally molded is adopted in consideration of energy loss generated at the joint between the voice coil bobbin and the diaphragm. This structure has been realized by deep drawing of titanium alloy, which had been difficult in the past. Since vibration of the voice coil bobbin is directly transmitted to the diaphragm, transient characteristics with good response and excellent pulsed sound are obtained. In addition, the area where heat generated from the voice coil bobbin escapes is expanded, and input resistance performance is improved.

NETWORK
A low-distortion network circuit is adopted in which the elements constituting the network circuit are carefully selected. This circuit uses a metallized polyester film capacitor with excellent high-frequency characteristics, an electrolytic capacitor with low distortion and low leakage current and dielectric loss, and a coil with laminated orient core with low DC resistance impregnated with special varnish. In addition, each device is firmly fixed, and attention is paid to the arrangement and wiring method of components so as to reduce interference between components. In addition, high-conductivity oxygen-free copper wires are used for internal wiring to enable high-purity transmission. It is equipped with a level control that allows 4-step switching in each of the middle and high ranges, and can be adjusted according to the situation. The front baffle has a vertical single row unit arrangement to improve the directivity of the high frequency range, and the left and right speakers have a symmetrical shape to improve sound image localization. The enclosure is carefully designed through repeated modal analysis and hearings. In addition, in order to increase the rigidity and confidentiality of the box, we have adopted a joint structure called ""wrapping and retaining hozo joint"" for the baffle plate joint. In addition, the resonance mode is dispersed by the distributed resonance structure with reinforcement placed in the right place to suppress the box ringing."

WOOFER
Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide fiber material with low density and moderate internal loss in addition to high strength and high specific elasticity. Amorphous silica is a fiber with high rigidity itself. By weaving these two fiber intra-ply structures and hybrid weaving, the skin material with high specific elastic modulus and optimum loss factor is obtained. The cellulose fiber skin used for the back skin is a skin material made from cellulose fiber with excellent internal loss. The hybrid structure of these two a hybrid structure, the optimum physical properties as a low-frequency diaphragm are realized while drawing out the advantages of each. The frame structure uses a highly rigid R. S. frame with an 8-point lock for secure mounting in the enclosure.midrangeThe mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. The cone part of the diaphragm employs an intra-ply hybrid diaphragm with an intra-ply structure made of organic fiber aramid and inorganic fiber PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber. The PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber uses polyacrylonitrile as a raw material and has an extremely high specific elastic modulus. By hybrid weaving this and the organic fiber aramid as an intra-ply structure, a high-dimensional balance between high specific elastic modulus and loss factor is achieved while keeping each characteristic high dimension. The center diaphragm of the diaphragm uses S. R. Titanium Dome which balances high specific elastic modulus and loss factor by surface hardening of titanium. By making the entire diaphragm a hybrid structure of a metal diaphragm and an FRP cone diaphragm, the connection of reproduced sound is improved. Tangential edge is used for the edge part. This edge is a laminated structure for resonance control with two tangential cloths coated with a special damping material to improve response, and realizes flattening of characteristics and reduction of strain. D structure in which the driving voice coil is directly wound around the diaphragm, we have achieved a wide response band and high-speed response to pulsed input at a high dimension. The unit structure adopts Diatone's unique D. M. (direct mount) structure. In the D. M. structure, part of the magnetic circuit is framed and mounted directly on the baffle plate. For the primary vibration mode, we increase the rigidity of the enclosure itself, and for the higher-order mode, we use Diatone's unique dispersion resonance type to reduce resonance. OtherThere was a special speaker stand, DK-77 which was developed for DS-77HR and sold separately. description:
## Description

"A speaker system incorporating new technologies such as A. D. M. C.

WOOFER
WooferA 31 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.

WOOFER
New Aramid Hybrid Honeycomb Cone is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm uses Aramid Hybrid FRP for the front skin and cellulose fiber skin for the back skin. Aramid Hybrid FRP has an intra-ply structure consisting of aramid aromatic polyamide organic fiber with high strength and moderate internal loss, and amorphous silica inorganic fiber with high rigidity. In DS-77Z, the rigidity of amorphous silica has been further improved by 15% compared to conventional products. By hybrid weaving these fibers, the skin material achieves both higher specific elastic modulus and optimum loss factor. By using the traditional honeycomb structure of the front skin and the cellulose fiber lining skin with excellent internal loss, the fusion of high rigidity and high internal loss is realized. The newly developed A. D. M. C. (Advanced Magnet Circuit) is used for the magnetic circuit of Woofer. Magnetostriction is caused by the distribution of DC magnetic flux, which is the driving energy, AC magnetic field generated by the current applied to the voice coil, and AC components in the magnetic flux. Diatone analyzed this using computer technology such as the finite element method, and developed A. D. M. C. which effectively suppresses magnetostriction. First, we examined the shape of the center pole to enhance the symmetry of the DC magnetic flux distribution across the voice coil. At the same time, we placed a conductive short ring on the center pole to offset the AC magnetic flux from the voice coil, thereby suppressing the magnetostriction caused by the superposition of DC and AC magnetic flux. Furthermore, by reducing the disturbance of the DC magnetic flux due to the AC magnetic flux in the magnetic circuit, the drive energy is stabilized and distortion is reduced at a high level. High-rigidity R. S. frame is used in the frame part to suppress unnecessary resonance.

MIDRANGE
midrangeThe mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. For the cone part of the diaphragm, we use an intra-ply hybrid diaphragm made by hybrid weaving of organic fiber aramid and inorganic fiber PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber. By combining PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber with extremely high specific elastic modulus and organic aramid with high strength and moderate internal loss, we realize a diaphragm that takes advantage of each other's characteristics. The center diaphragm of the diaphragm uses S. R. titanium dome, which has high specific elastic modulus and internal loss by surface hardening of titanium. The edge uses a tangential edge that has been coated with a special damping material to improve responsiveness. In order to control resonance, this edge has a laminated structure of two tangential cloths to realize flattening of characteristics and reduction of strain. The voice coil uses an extremely high-purity oxygen-free copper of 6N (99.9999%) to realize a sound with little distortion. The R. S. frame, which strongly supports the magnetic circuit and controls resonance, has been adopted in the frame part for higher rigidity. TweeterA 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. Boron D. U. D. dome is used for the diaphragm. Boron is second only to diamond in hardness and has excellent characteristics such as sound velocity. At the same time, it has physical properties closer to porcelain rather than metal. In addition, DS-77Z has been reviewing boron in various ways, focusing on characteristics such as high specific elastic modulus, high durability and weather resistance, and proper sound control. In addition, the D. U. D structure that integrates the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin transfers driving force to the diaphragm without loss, and realizes high limit frequency, linearity, and improved input resistance. The frame structure adopts D. M. method, and the plate part which is a part of magnetic circuit is directly mounted. The DS-77Z has a hybrid structure in which the entire plate is mounted with aluminum alloy sheathing in order to eliminate resonance of the magnetic circuit components. In addition to high rigidity, the DS-77Z has an appropriate damping property.

POWER SUPPLY
NETWORK
NetworkA crimping wiring method is used for connection of the network section, and an independent power supply method is used to eliminate interference between each unit and network. In addition, the split structure with separate woofer elements prevents noise from becoming cloudy due to magnetic flux leakage. Laminated oriented cores are used for coils, oxygen-free copper wires are used for electrical wires, and capacitors and resistors are also carefully selected. EnclosureThe front baffle uses a 2-side round baffle to suppress sound quality degradation caused by the diffraction effect of sound waves.

ENCLOSURE
The enclosure has a highly rigid distributed resonance structure utilizing our unique analytical technology.

CABINET
ENCLOSURE
In addition, a 30 mm thick baffle is adopted to further increase rigidity, and resolution is improved. OtherThe DS-77Z has a full-scale anti-magnetic design. There were 2 kinds of variations for the speaker stand sold separately."

"This is a bookshelf speaker system developed by inheriting the concept inherited from the DS 505 to the DS 503.

By using a honeycomb structure, internal loss is improved by 20% compared with paper. In addition, harmonic distortion due to split vibration is reduced by 15 dB compared with paper cone. By this, the upper limit frequency is passed to the higher band, and the reproduction frequency band is expanded. In addition, by making this material a D. U. D structure, the driving force generated in the voice coil can be transmitted to the Ï‰-titanium diaphragm without loss, and the response to input signals is improved with less attenuation in the high frequency range. A 2.5 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range. This unit uses a D. U. D Ï‰-titanium diaphragm similar to the mid-range. The network circuit uses Diatone's unique low-distortion network circuit.

description:
## Description

"This 4-way speaker system is designed to be a bookshelf that exceeds the bookshelf type and is compatible with digital audio. The DS 505 has a 4-way configuration with a mid-bus unit, and the mid-bus unit is equipped with fundamental bandwidth to achieve both high resolution in the mid-range and high quality in the low frequency range, which was difficult to achieve with the conventional 3-way system. A 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The diaphragm uses a newly developed aramid honeycomb cone.

WOOFER
Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide fiber that combines high strength and high elasticity with low density and moderate internal loss. Diatone uses a special blend of flexible resin reinforced with aramid fiber to create a honeycomb diaphragm with a large internal loss in the resin itself. This skin and aluminum honeycomb core bonded together. The voice coil uses a polyimide film with three times the Young's modulus of conventional aromatic polyamide film and excellent heat and cold resistance. It is designed to dramatically improve input resistance and to transmit the driving force generated by the voice coil to the diaphragm without loss. The magnetic circuit is equipped with a low-distortion magnetic circuit. In this method, a nickel-based magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics is developed and installed in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap using a metallurgical engineering approach to reduce non-linear strain. Furthermore, regarding strain based on non-uniformity of magnetic flux density distribution in the magnetic gap, the effects of shapes, dimensions, materials, etc. of the pole piece and plate are analyzed by a computer to realize a structure with uniform magnetic flux density distribution and less strain. A 16 cm cone type midbus unit is installed in the middle and low range. This unit uses voice coil and low distortion magnetic circuit using aramid honeycomb cone and polyimide film as well as woofer.

TWEETER
A 4 cm dome type mid-high unit is installed in the middle and high area. This unit uses a sandwiched boronized diaphragm made of titanium treated with high-temperature boronization. Moreover, this diaphragm has a DUD structure unique to Diatone, which integrates the voice coil bobbin and diaphragm. This diaphragm prevents a decrease in rigidity caused by bonding the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin and eliminates high resonance frequencies out of the audible band. In addition, by eliminating energy loss at the bonded part, the driving force generated in the voice coil can be transmitted to the diaphragm without loss, reducing attenuation in the high frequency range. Moreover, since the heat generated in the voice coil is directly conducted to the diaphragm, the increase in conductor resistance of the voice coil itself due to temperature rise is prevented, and linearity and input resistance to input signals are improved. A large strontium magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and the distortion of the drive system caused by the magnetic circuit is eliminated by operating the magnetic circuit in the saturation region. A 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range. Similar to the mid-high unit, this unit uses a boronized diaphragm and a large strontium magnet. In order to reduce distortion in network circuits, we have been studying constituent parts and elements. The coil for the network is designed to take advantage of both the good damping of the core and the low distortion of the air core. Therefore, the shape of the coil is thoroughly pursued and the winding diameter is increased to 1.4 mm to reduce DC resistance and distortion. In addition, careful attention is paid to the production of the element such as using a bonded iron core made by heat-pressing silicon steel plate with a special adhesive in order to suppress harmful core noise. We have adopted a polyester film capacitor with excellent high-frequency characteristics. This capacitor is also designed with double vibration isolation structure in consideration of its own vibration. We have also adopted a low-distortion type electrolytic capacitor with extremely low leakage current and dielectric loss. We also pay attention to the layout of network components and wiring methods, and reduce distortion to minimize interference between components. Oxygen-free copper wires are used mainly for network circuit wiring. Compared with general tough pitch copper wires, oxygen-free copper wires have superior characteristics such as high conductivity, no hydrogen embrittlement, excellent workability, and low content of impurities such as dissimilar metals. In addition, we have eliminated the need for soldering and adopted a crimping connection using a oxygen-free copper sleeve. The enclosure uses a joint structure and material determined by modal analysis and repeated thorough hearing to bring out the performance of the unit. Also, the mounting position of the unit was determined by modal analysis and repeated listening of various prototype model systems. By this method, the midbus unit is placed on the upper part and intermodulation distortion is suppressed."

description:
## Description

"A high-density and high-resolution speaker system designed to achieve high-speed start-up response. In the development of the DS 2000, digital measurement was introduced ahead of the industry. Problems in time domain response are discovered through modal analysis and energy time response analysis, and the results of each research and analysis are fed into each department to enhance the completeness.

WOOFER
WooferA 30 cm cone shaped woofer with Diatone's unique honeycomb construction cone is installed in the low range. In the DS 2000, high-tensile polyamide fiber is used for the skin material, and along with the development of special matrix resins, the diaphragm itself is reduced in strain. In addition, the curved cone shape is used to reduce high-order harmonic distortion, and the upper limit frequencies are expanded. The voice coil bobbin uses a polyimide film that has three times the specific elastic modulus of conventional aromatic polyamide film and excellent heat and cold resistance. This improves input resistance and response to input signals. DMM (Direct Magnet Circuit Mount) system is adopted for the frame part. In this system, the whole unit including the magnetic circuit is wrapped in a strong aluminum die-cast frame pressed from the rear so that the magnetic circuit and the frame are effectively integrated. In addition, the DS 2000 incorporates new technologies such as 8-frame and uniform 8-point fastening based on vibration analysis using a vibration pickup. By integrating the frame and fastening screws, resonance of the magnetic circuit and frame is suppressed.midrangeA 6 cm dome type squaker using a newly designed 60 mm reinforced diffused boron D. U. D. diaphragm is mounted in the middle area. The diaphragm structure of this unit uses Diatone Unified Diaphragm (D. U. D.). In this structure, the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated by a simple structure in which the voice coil is wound directly on the diaphragm, and the driving force generated by the voice coil is directly transmitted to the diaphragm without loss. Therefore, the damping of the high frequency range is small, and the transient response to the input vibration is improved. In addition, there is no decrease in rigidity due to adhesion, and the upper limit frequency can be set high, and the increase in conductor resistance due to temperature rise is reduced by the excellent heat radiation effect, and linearity and input resistance are improved. Boron is used for the diaphragm. Boron is second only to diamond in hardness and has excellent acoustic properties such as specific elastic modulus. At the same time, boron has physical properties closer to magnetism than metals. By this property, characteristics at the resonance frequency can be smoothed, and neither braking nor acoustic equalization to the diaphragm itself is required, thus realizing an ideal diaphragm. In addition, in order to further develop the characteristics of the boron diaphragm in the DS 2000, boron diffusion growth is strongly promoted, and boronization of the titanium base metal is promoted by crystal growth boron to improve the completion of the diaphragm. In addition, the diaphragm itself is a no-treatment diaphragm that does not use any damping material to take advantage of the excellent response characteristic of the D. U. D structure. DM (direct mount) system is adopted for the frame part. In this system, the magnetic circuit itself is made into a frame by integrating the magnetic circuit and the frame into a monocoque structure, and by mounting it directly into the enclosure, the rigidity of the whole unit is increased. In addition, by comprehensively examining magnetic flux density, magnetic flux leakage, rigidity, etc., and determining the optimum shape and dimensions using a finite element method using a computer, high-density mid-range reproduction is achieved.

ENCLOSURE
In addition, the plate portion is 8 mm thick with allowance, and it is fixed to the baffle plate at 8 equal points in high rigid incorporation, and the unit input terminal position and structure are also devised in order to minimize the diameter of the baffle. TweeterThe high-frequency band is equipped with a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using an enhanced diffused boron D. U. D. diaphragm in the same way as the mid-frequency band. CABINET
ENCLOSURE
NETWORK
NetworkIn order to reduce the effects of electromagnetic interference between network circuits and vibration of the enclosure, a 3-piece separation and division method is adopted for the network section. EnclosureThe enclosure is designed using modal analysis and other computer-based vibration analysis technology. In the DS 2000, materials with high rigidity and low natural sound are selected. The high-order mode is suppressed by the dispersion resonance structure of the Diatone tradition, and the low-order mode increases the rigidity of the enclosure itself as a box to balance the vibration as a whole. In addition, the joint strength of 6 especially important enclosures is also examined. The machining accuracy of the joint surface is improved by improving the accuracy of the machine tool, and a sturdy box assembly is realized by joining with strong adhesive and reinforcing with angle block."

name: DP-EC1
description:
## Description

"A record player that achieves both basic performance and automatic mechanism by introducing EC (Electronic Control) system. In order to maintain high basic performance even after automation, we have adopted a non-contact arm position detection mechanism that does not apply any side pressure to the arm. Since the arm lifter is designed to operate while detecting the state of the arm lifter (whether the arm is up or down) and the position of the arm within the horizontal drive without contact, automatic operation is possible from any position. In addition, manual operation is possible without switching between auto and manual operation except when the arm is moving with auto. The system uses a reflector to detect the size of a record. In this system, a reflector (prism) emits light from obliquely above the record, guides the light to a sensor corresponding to each record size, and sends the output from the sensor to a logic circuit to determine the size of the record. This size detection mechanism automatically determines the needle down position, performance end position, and turntable rotation speed during automatic performance. A true black switch is used for the control knob. The automatic mechanism is controlled by an IC-based logic circuit. This control section is composed of a combination of highly reliable ICs to eliminate problems such as wear and misalignment.

TONE ARM
The tone arm is equipped with a unique mechanism that incorporates a damper inside the counterweight to damp resonance. In addition, the rigidity of the pipe section is increased by using a stronger stainless steel pipe instead of conventional aluminum pipe. The plug-in part for attaching the head shell adopts a chuck type plug-in mechanism, and by tightening the head shell from four directions, the connection between the head shell and the pipe part is more reliable. In addition, by expanding the span of the vertical pivot and adopting a full-scale radial ball bearing for water plain bearing, the force acting in the direction of pulling and twisting the pipe is reduced. Separate motors for the horizontal and vertical directions are used to drive the tone arm to prevent it from affecting the turntable drive system. The drive motor is a direct drive motor that uses an integral type FG method for detecting rotational speed (a method that converts rotational speed into frequency for detection).

MOTOR
In addition, the direct drive type has a disadvantage in torque because it does not have a reduction mechanism, but by using a DC motor with a starting torque of 1.2 starting torque of kg Ï‰ cm. In addition to the 1.8 kg turntable, consideration has been given to the turntable seat. The turntable sheet is designed to have a slight mortar shape based on the results of the examination of hardness, specific gravity, thickness and adhesion to the record and sound quality. The material is determined based on the tone arm and other properties, and is designed to have a maximum thickness of 5.5 mm, specific gravity of 2.0, and hardness of 40. Electronic slide system using LED is adopted. In the case of a strobe device using a neon lamp, since the light emission time is long, the stroboscopic stripes move during the light emission, causing blurring. To reduce this blurring, an electronic circuit generates a signal with a pulse width as short as 1/1000 second using a commercial frequency and drives the LED by this signal. It is equipped with an electronic muting mechanism. Uses precision die-cast base."

name: DP-EC1MKII
description:
## Description

"An EC (electronically controlled) full auto player released as a successor to the DP-EC1. The counter weight of the tone arm has a built-in anti-resonance filter. This anti-resonance mechanism reduces resonance in the 30 Hz to 80 Hz range and improves resolution in the low frequency range. In addition, stainless steel pipe with high rigidity is adopted for the pipe arm instead of the conventional aluminum pipe, and it is combined with the counter weight with the damper built-in, and the deflection of the pipe part is almost eliminated. A force is applied to the tone arm in the direction of twisting or pulling the pipe. If the pivot is loose at this time, these forces will be applied to the needle tip and the sound quality will deteriorate. To prevent this, the span of the pivot is expanded, and a full-scale radial ball bearing is used for water plain bearing. This eliminates the looseness of the pipe and suppresses resonance. The tone arm is driven by two separate motors, one for horizontal direction and the other for vertical direction. All the conductors in the arm and the head shell are made of pure silver wire with special coating, which reduces DC resistance and improves the sound rise to improve the sound quality in the mid and high range. The head shell is made of magnesium alloy. The automatic record size detection mechanism uses an optical system to detect the record size without touching the record. The principle of this automatic record size detection mechanism is that a reflector emits light from obliquely above a record and guides the light to a sensor corresponding to each record size. The light to the sensor is blocked or emitted depending on the record size, and its output changes depending on the record size. The output from the sensor is then sent to a logic circuit that determines the size of the record. Then, the needle down position, performance end position, and rotation speed of the automatic performance are determined automatically. In addition, with DP-EC1mkII, it is possible to finely adjust the position of the needle effect on the record board by pressing the button. The DP-EC1mkII is designed to operate without contact at all times while detecting the state of the arm lifter (up / down) and the horizontal position of the arm, so that it can operate automatically from any position. Manual operation is possible without switching between Auto and Manual except when the arm is moved by Auto operation. Equipped with a quick response mechanism, even when the arm is moving up or down in automatic operation, if you instruct a new operation with the button, you can immediately move to the next operation. A quartz PLL system is used to control the rotation of the turntable. In this system, the rotation speed of the motor is controlled by a high-precision reference signal from a crystal oscillator.

name: DP-EC1MKIII
description:
## Description

"A full auto player based on DP-EC1mkII with further improvements. An electronically controlled full-auto mechanism allows all tone arm operations to be controlled simply by pressing the operation buttons. In addition, a single-chip LSI circuit is used for quick and accurate response. It uses an automatic record size detection mechanism by applying an optical system. In this system, the reflector emits light from obliquely above and guides the light from the turntable seat reflector to the sensor. Equipped with a quick response function, it operates while always detecting the condition of the arm lifter and arm. Therefore, it is possible to perform auto operation from any position. In addition, by expanding the span of the pivot, looseness of the pipe part is eliminated, and high sensitivity is achieved in both vertical and horizontal directions. The tone arm is driven by a dedicated motor that is independent in both horizontal and vertical directions. Titanium alloy is used for the material of the tone arm. description:

This anti-resonance mechanism reduces resonance in the 30 Hz to 80 Hz range and improves resolution in the low frequency range. In addition, stainless steel pipe with high rigidity is adopted for the pipe arm instead of the conventional aluminum pipe, and it is combined with the counter weight with the damper built-in, and the deflection of the pipe part is almost eliminated. A force is applied to the tone arm in the direction of twisting or pulling the pipe. If the pivot is loose at this time, these forces will be applied to the needle tip and the sound quality will deteriorate. To prevent this, the span of the pivot is expanded, and a full-scale radial ball bearing is used for water plain bearing. This eliminates the looseness of the pipe and suppresses resonance. The tone arm is driven by two separate motors, one for horizontal direction and the other for vertical direction. Sound quality is improved by keeping the total DC resistance from the head shell to the output cord and pin plug low. The head shell is made of magnesium alloy. The principle of this automatic record size detection mechanism is that a reflector emits light from obliquely above a record and guides the light to a sensor corresponding to each record size. The light to the sensor is blocked or emitted depending on the record size, and its output changes depending on the record size. The output from the sensor is then sent to a logic circuit, which determines the size of the record. Then, the needle down position and the end position of the automatic performance are determined automatically. For DP-EC3, the rotational speed is manually determined. Equipped with a quick response mechanism, even when the arm is moving up or down in automatic operation, if you instruct a new operation with the button, you can immediately move to the next operation. A quartz PLL system is used to control the rotation of the turntable. In this system, the rotation speed of the motor is controlled by a high-precision reference signal from a crystal oscillator.

MOTOR
The motor also uses a 4-phase 12-pole quartz PLL / DC servo motor with a starting torque of 1.2 kg Ï‰ cm. The turntable has an outer diameter of 333 mm, a weight of 1.8 kg, and an inertial mass of 353g-cmS.2Turntable is adopted. By gathering all operation buttons on the front of the cabinet, it can be operated even with the dust cover closed.

ENCLOSURE

name: LT-1
description:
## Description

"A linear tracking system full auto player developed by gathering DIATONE technology. It employs a linear tracking system in which the arm moves linearly on the record board in the same way as the cutting machine. In this system, the tangential direction of the groove is accurately traced, so tracking error and harmonic distortion can be reduced. In addition, since there is no inside force, the needle tip can contact the object, so that overall tracking capability can be improved. A stainless steel wire is used for the drive of the moving base that fixes the tone arm. This wire combines 49 fine wires of 0.05 mm diameter with nylon coating to obtain excellent durability and flexibility. Tracking error is detected by the potential difference between the two photodiode outputs at the rear of the arm, and the error angle is suppressed to 0.03 � to 0.05 �. As for the vibration caused by the movement of the arm base, the vibration generated in the moving base of the arm should be minimized. Second, the vibration generated in the moving base should not be transmitted to the needle tip. Therefore, prior to designing, we have modeled a movement-based mechanism, established equations of motion, and conducted computer simulations to optimize the actual values of each element. We have also carefully determined the position of the optimum driving point and the position of the arm support point based on the center of impact theory. It uses an electronically controlled full-auto mechanism. This allows all tone arm operations to be controlled simply by pressing the operation button. The circuit uses a 1-chip LSI for quick and accurate response. It uses an automatic record size detection mechanism by applying an optical system. In this system, the reflector emits light from obliquely above and guides the light from the turntable seat reflector to the sensor. This light is emitted or blocked depending on the size of the record and changes the output of the sensor. This output is sent to a logic circuit that automatically detects the record size. Based on the detected record size, the needle down position and rotation speed are automatically determined. Equipped with a quick response function, it operates while always detecting the condition of the arm lifter and arm. Therefore, it is possible to perform auto operation from any position. Thus, even when the arm is ascending or descending in auto operation, if you indicate the next new operation with the button, it will move immediately to that operation. For button operation, feather touch type using micro switch is adopted. Equipped with a muting mechanism to cut noise.

TONE ARM
In order to suppress the resonance of the tone arm, a weight case and a butyl rubber damper are added to the structure of the needle pressure knob and main weight, and an anti-resonance filter is adopted. In addition, by expanding the span of the pivot, looseness of the pipe part is eliminated, and high sensitivity is achieved in both vertical and horizontal directions. Titanium alloy is used for the material of the tone arm. Special coated OFC (oxygen-free conductor) is used for the inner arm conductor and head shell conductor.

TURNTABLE
The turntable has a double-metal structure consisting of an aluminum die-cast turntable and a stainless steel plate. When vibration occurs on the turntable, slip occurs between the two metals and vibration energy is consumed to reduce vibration. The turntable is driven by a quartz PLL system that controls the number of revolutions of the motor according to the reference signal of the crystal oscillator.

TRANSPORT
MOTOR
A high-torque DC servo motor with a precisely finished bearing mechanism is used as the drive motor.

ENCLOSURE
The cabinet structure consists of a die-cast player board and a 40-mm-thick laminate fixed to it. Weight 700g Equipped with brass disk stabilizers to promote close contact between the record board and the sheet, improving the SN ratio and resolution in the low frequency range."

name: LT-5V
description: Audio Database DIATONE LT-5V/LT-5VC LT-5V : ¥ 69,800 (around 1979) LT-5VC : ¥ 79,800 (around 1979) Commentary A vertical-type record player that uses a linear tracking system. There were 2 types, LT-5V without cartridge and LT-5VC with Diatone original cartridge MM-2 made by Orthophone. The LT-5V has a vertical structure that is rare for a record player. In a typical horizontal player, since the direction of vibration of the cartridge and the direction of floor vibration are the same, when mechanical vibration caused by tracing of the sound groove is converted into electrical signal by the cartridge, floor vibration is combined with the reproduced signal, which causes howling phenomenon. On the other hand, the vertical player has a structure that is resistant to howling because the direction of floor vibration does not interfere with the direction of vibration for the cartridge to generate power. Since the direction of the weight of the cartridge is different from the direction of the needle pressure, once the appropriate needle pressure is set, there is almost no trouble of readjusting the needle pressure even if the cartridge is replaced. The tone arm uses a linear tracking system. In this system, the tone arm is moved horizontally along with the fulcrum, so it operates in exactly the same way as a cutting machine that cuts a sound groove in the original record. The LT-5V consists of two parts : an optical sensor part that detects the verticality of the tone arm and a drive part that operates the tone arm based on commands from the tracking servo circuit. First, an optical sensor detects the verticality of the tone arm part and the base part, which are supported from the arm base in the direction of gravity (downward), and the output generated by the angle difference is transmitted to the tracking servo circuit. The optical sensor that quickly reacts to even slight angle difference and the tracking servo circuit with high accuracy rotate the horizontal drive motor

name: DA-F630
description:
## Description

"An FM/AM tuner that can preset 8 FM/AM stations. It uses a quartz synthesizer method. This method enables electronic tuning by changing the capacitance of a variable diode using a PLL and a microcomputer. The receiving frequency is determined based on the reference frequency (FM0.1 MHz, AM1kHz) obtained from the crystal oscillator, so there is no worry about tuning deviation. By storing frequencies in a microcomputer, you can preset up to 8 stations in total.

POWER SUPPLY
Since the power supply of the memory is a condenser backup system, the memory circuit operates even if the power switch is turned off. Even if the power supply is turned off due to a power failure or absence recording, the preset state is maintained for approximately 48 hours. You can set the preset by pressing the memory button while receiving the desired station and pressing the desired preset button while the memory indicator is lit. Manual tuning is possible using the UP/DOWN buttons. Each press of each button changes the received frequency in 0.1 MHz steps for FM and 1 kHz steps for AM. You can also fast-forward tune by holding down the button. The FM detection circuit employs a new quadrature detector in which a phase coil and a detection transformer are contained in the same case. In addition, a PLL IC is employed in the MPX circuit to achieve low distortion and high separation. The frequency is digitally displayed by the LED."

"FM stereo tuner using quartz PLL synthesizer system. A quartz PLL synthesizer method is used. In this method, a 100 kHz reference signal is produced by reducing the frequency of a 6.4 MHz signal obtained from a crystal oscillator with high frequency accuracy to 1/64 with a frequency divider. The phase of this 100 kHz pulse is compared with the phase of the local oscillator output, and if there is a phase difference, the local oscillation frequency is controlled so that the phase difference becomes small. A pilot cancel type stereo demodulator is used. This pilot cancellation method cancels the pilot signal by adding a pilot signal of opposite phase to the input of the decoder, so that the output of the stereo demodulator does not leak the 19 kHz pilot signal. The front end section uses a special precision 5-row varicon for FM to obtain accurate dial accuracy and stability. We have also obtained excellent spurious and intermodulation interference characteristics by using carefully selected dual-gate MOS FETs with low noise figure for the high-frequency amplification stage and mixing stage, a double-tuned circuit for the RF tuning circuit, and a 4-pole phase-linear LC filter for the mixer transformer. The local oscillator circuit uses an oscillation coil with an aluminum core and a Teflon trimmer capacitor, and these components are mounted on a glass-epoxy board. The IF stage employs a 4-pole phase-linear LC filter with a linear phase over a wide frequency range. The new design of the discli-transformer and PLL MPX IC realizes excellent characteristics. It has a built-in air check oscillator (calibrator) that oscillates the signal sound of 440 Hz at the same output as that of 50% FM modulation."

name: DS-28B
description:
## Description

"A speaker system developed to realize dynamic and high-presence playback.

WOOFER
A 25 cm cone type woofer, PW 2521 bma, is mounted in the low range. The cone paper of this unit is composed of a mixture of three kinds of pulp and moderately beaten Japanese paper with excellent physical properties placed as a key point. It realizes a diaphragm for sealed use with both airtightness and moderate loss. In addition, the U-shaped edge with excellent dynamic linearity is used for the edge. The neutral position of this edge is slightly shifted in the stationary state so that the neutral position can be kept well in the operating state. In addition, the newly developed material is used. Various aspects such as the study of the physical properties of the fiber itself, the thickness of the fiber for a non-directional weave, and the ratio of warp and weft are examined. The surface of the edge is coated with a mixture of thermosetting resin and viscoelastic resin in several times, and a special damping treatment is applied at the final finish to ensure smooth movement. The magnetic circuit uses an expensive Alnico cast magnet to reduce distortion and stabilize dynamic characteristics. In addition, the magnet material uses MK magnet (made by Mitsubishi Steel) with large BH product developed for high-grade speakers. A 4 mm thick aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame to reduce the natural vibration of the frame and unnecessary sound emission from the frame itself.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with PM-1021CM which is a 10 cm cone type squaker. A catenary curved cone is used for the cone. The cone section of this cone follows the catenary curve. When the cone paper is panned from pulp, it is panned in a very natural manner so that no strain occurs inside the fiber. In addition, since the stress vector generated inside the cone from the voice coil to the edge direction follows a natural form, no abnormal or natural vibration occurs, and smooth characteristics and stable physical properties are obtained. In addition, by adopting a matched resonant type with corrugation, a wide range of directional characteristics and cone strength are obtained. In addition, the center cap is subjected to a damping treatment to suppress the natural vibration of the cap itself by analyzing the vibration mode using laser holography, thereby suppressing the radiation of strain sound from the center cap and adverse effects on the vibration of the cone paper. V-shaped Cross Edge is used for the edge part. This edge is V-shaped considering that it has excellent linearity within the practical range of amplitude and is strong against lateral vibration. Thick fiber is used for the material to realize the edge with high stiffness. In addition, by coating damping and quantity on this V-shaped Cross Edge, airtightness is increased and linearity is further improved. This V-shaped Cross Edge greatly improves linearity at small amplitude. This unit is equipped with a fully enclosed back chamber in the rear part of the diaphragm. By using an acoustic load type in which sound absorbing material is filled in the air quality, interference with the woofer is suppressed and intermodulation distortion is reduced.

TWEETER
A 3 cm dome type tweeter, DH-2203CMA, is mounted in the high range. A polyester resin diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. This material was determined by vibration analysis of the diaphragm using laser holography. Since it has appropriate rigidity and internal loss, it has high efficiency and smooth characteristics. In addition, in order to prevent performance degradation due to rolling phenomenon and aging, a very narrow straight edge is adopted at the edge. This straight edge is supported by a unique sandwich structure and fixed via an elastic body, thereby eliminating abnormal resonance and unnecessary sound at the edge.

NETWORK
The network section uses a soft displacement type coil with no change in sound quality from low level to high level and good sound expansion even with large input. In addition to improving sound transparency, we have adopted a bipolar capacitor that uses plain foils, which are highly reliable even under the influence of Dainyu. Level control is provided for the middle and high frequencies.

ENCLOSURE
The enclosure is hermetically sealed and has a unique distributed resonant structure. In the distributed resonance enclosure, the vibration pattern of the cabinet is physically analyzed and the reinforcement elements are unevenly distributed.

ENCLOSURE
No simple joining methods are used in the cabinet joint structure, and all joints are made with a strong structure requiring advanced woodworking techniques. This disperses the resonance modes and prevents the cabinet from resonating too much in a certain bandwidth.

CABINET
The cabinet is made of high-density multi-layer particleboards with excellent acoustic characteristics.

ENCLOSURE
The front baffle has an edge-less structure. Instead of the recessed front baffle used in conventional speakers, the edge around the baffle plate has been removed to improve directional characteristics."

WOOFER
A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. Corn paper is made from carefully selected pulp and processed by the air-dry method. It is made into a curved cone with thick corrugation. In this method, the metal does not directly touch the corn paper during molding, so it can obtain strength with moderate internal loss for the diaphragm. In addition, the dust cap is an air-dry type with the surface pressed by mesh to prevent the inside from falling out which tends to occur in 2-way systems. The frame is made of thick die-cast to suppress resonance and improve resolution.

TWEETER
A 6 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range. This unit uses a back chamber with an orifice structure, which is also used in the DS-25B. A sub-frame with an orifice in the chamber is attached to provide acoustic braking, eliminating the deterioration of transients. In addition, the center cap is made of titanium with excellent rigidity to prevent split vibration. The enclosure uses a bass reflex system using a triangular duct with a triangular opening. The triangular duct suppresses resonance inside the duct, standing waves inside the cabinet, and natural vibrations of the duct itself. This eliminates turbidity in the mid - and high-frequency range and improves resolution in the low-frequency range. In addition, a distributed resonance structure has been adopted for the internal structure to disperse the resonance mode and eliminate the box sound."

description:

"This bookshelf speaker system offers a wide range and a wide dynamic range.

A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. This unit uses a low-distortion magnetic circuit equipped with an FN ring, which is also used in the DS-35BmkII, etc., to greatly reduce the distortion of the magnetic circuit. In addition, by installing a 120 mm diameter magnet in the magnetic circuit, the amplitude distortion is suppressed and a damped low sound is obtained. In addition, in order to realize the slow low sound reproduction characteristic of the bass reflex system, the press pressure of the cone paper is relatively low and close to non-press. TWEETER

The parts include a core coil with low transmission loss and a metallized polyester film capacitor with low distortion. Equipped with level controls for the middle and high frequencies, each of which can be switched in four stages. The front baffle has a symmetrical unit layout with the squaker and tweeter positioned slightly inward from the center line of the baffle plate to improve sound image localization. name: DS-35B
description:
## Description

"A speaker system that reduces distortion by adopting a low-distortion magnetic circuit. The newly developed low-distortion magnetic circuit is used for the magnetic circuit of Woofer and midrange. Drive system distortion, which is non-linear distortion generated from the speaker, is caused by non-linear magnetic characteristics of magnetic material near the voice coil and non-uniform magnetic flux distribution in the gap where the voice coil is placed. In order to reduce this problem, the low-distortion magnetic circuit uses a special magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics, which is produced by the metallurgical optical approach, in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap. This reduces the non-linear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to conventional speakers.

WOOFER
A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. By placing an effective corrugation on the cone paper and examining the material, molding method, additives, etc. from all angles, distortion due to split vibration, etc. is reduced. In addition, a die-cast frame is used for the frame.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. The edge of this unit is made of polyester resin film, which had been considered difficult to put into practical use until then. Special damping treatment is applied to control the characteristics. In addition, this edge has excellent linearity in minute amplitude, and suppresses the generation of distortion by preventing the rolling and torsional vibration of the cone. Die-cast frame is used for the frame.

TWEETER
A 3-cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. GFRP (Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastics) composite material is used for the diaphragm. Since this material is light and has high rigidity, the piston vibration range is extended and divided vibration is reduced. Moreover, since natural vibration is difficult to occur, high-end characteristics are also flat. Level control is provided for the middle and high frequencies.

ENCLOSURE
The cabinet adopts a distributed resonance type, and vibration is suppressed by a strong joint structure and a special distributed reinforcing bar, and box ringing phenomenon is suppressed by dispersing resonance mode."

"This speaker system further reduces distortion by introducing new technology based on the DS-35B. This reduces the nonlinear distortion of the drive system generated by the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 compared with conventional speakers. The DS-35BmkII employs a low-distortion network circuit to further reduce distortion and improve sound quality. A strong die-cast frame is used for the frame, and a straight tapered shape is used for the flange part to solve the characteristic disturbance caused by reflection.

"A floor-type speaker system with low distortion and improved resolution.

name: DS-90C
description:
## Description

"This high-end floor speaker system was developed by combining the latest technology and know-how accumulated through many years of speaker production.

WOOFER
A 40 cm cone type woofer using HC (honeycomb construction) cone is mounted in the low range. The HC cone has a honeycomb-shaped honeycomb core made of thin aluminum foil sandwiched between thin glass fiber reinforced plastic (GFRP) films on both sides. As a result, the air layer occupies around 90% of the entire vibration plate, realizing a lightweight and highly rigid vibration plate. The HC cone has an extremely large weight-to-strength ratio and weight-to-rigidity ratio compared to other vibration plates, so the strain generated from the piston vibration region can be significantly reduced. In addition, by attaching a foam damping sheet on the back side of the vibration plate, an appropriate amount of internal loss is given and natural vibration is suppressed. A low-distortion magnetic field circuit is used for the magnetic circuit. In this magnetic circuit, a special low-distortion ring (FN ring) made of iron-nickel alloy is installed in the magnetic pole gap to reduce non-linear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to conventional speakers. A 16 cm cone type squaker is mounted in the middle area. It uses low-distortion magnetic circuits that are also used in the Woofer, selected cone paper, Cross Edge with moderate viscoelasticity, voice coil with excellent input resistance, and die-cast frame. It has been developed through careful measurement and hearing tests. In addition, since the directivity of the woofer begins to deteriorate at around 500 Hz, the crossover frequency is set to 350 Hz and used up to 3.5 kHz in order to compensate for this.

TWEETER
A 5 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. The effective vibration radius of the cone is designed to be as small as possible. In addition to maintaining excellent directivity up to high frequencies, the piston vibration range is extended to reduce split vibration, and transient is improved by suppressing distortion. The allowable input is increased by designing the voice coil diameter to be large. In addition, the center dome has a special conical shape to increase rigidity and extend the piston vibration range to improve characteristics. The squaker and tweeter are fixed in a sturdy diecast baffle 10 mm thick to prevent cavity resonance in the back of the squaker for a clear mid-to-high sound range without turbidity. The symmetrical arrangement of the units improves the directional characteristics of stereo playback. A triangular duct is used for the bass reflex port to prevent resonance inside the duct and standing wave inside the cabinet. The enclosure is a large enclosure with an internal volume of 206 liters. The internal structure is of a distributed resonance type. The vibration pattern of the enclosure is physically analyzed and reinforcing bars are distributed unevenly to suppress box rumbling. The joints are firmly fixed using sophisticated woodworking techniques."

description:
## Description

"The third installment of the DS Series is a 3-way speaker system that adds a super-tweeter to the 2-way speaker system. The DS 251 sold a total of 600000 units until the model was changed to the DS 251 mkII in 1973 and production was discontinued in 1976.

WOOFER

TWEETER
A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range. This unit is an acoustic type unit in which sound absorbing material is packed in the air chamber at the rear of the diaphragm. The same 3 cm cone type super tweeter as DS 301 is mounted in the super high range. This unit uses aluminum alloy molded plates for the diaphragm and suspension. name: DS-303
description:
## Description

"This speaker system was developed as a high-end model following the DS 301. In order to realize an excellent speaker, it is designed not only by measuring in an anechoic room, but also by measuring under various conditions such as characteristics when placed directly on a floor plate and characteristics when embedded in the ground assuming an infinite baffle.

WOOFER
A 30 cm cone type woofer, PW-30BM is mounted in the low range. 3040 bm. It is equipped with DM-6010CM which is a 6 cm dome type squaker in the middle range, DH-2310CM which is a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter in the high range, and DH-1670BM which is a 1.6 cm dome type super tweeter in the ultra high range. The diaphragms of these units are made of phenol resin, paper, and soft aluminum from the viewpoint of performance and sound quality, respectively, and we have succeeded in obtaining natural sound connections.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range, high-range and ultra-high-range are equipped with independent coil tap step-type attenuators. You can control four levels each for the middle and high ranges, and three levels for the ultra high range. In the DS 303, the Woofer unit is damped at 600 Hz, which is one octave lower than the piston vibration limit, and connected to the Skoker unit. In addition, the Woofer unit is connected to the Tweeter unit at 5 kHz, which is one octave lower than the limit frequency of the Skoker. In addition, the Tweeter is connected to the Super Tweeter at 10 kHz, which is one octave lower than the frequency at which the characteristics begin to be disturbed as it enters the divided resonance range. As a result, the crossover frequency is naturally connected and the power response is smooth. The good range of piston vibration stabilizes the characteristics of the speaker unit and stabilizes the physical characteristics and sound quality of the system. The enclosure uses a symmetrical design for the first time as a diatone. By improving directional characteristics, the difference in sound quality between the left and right sides of the system is eliminated.

CABINET
ENCLOSURE
In addition, an edgeless cabinet with a flat outer periphery of the front baffle has been adopted to improve the directional disturbance that occurs when the outer periphery of the front baffle protrudes from the design of old speaker systems. In addition, to eliminate the influence of the front net, a slit is installed on both sides of the front and left sides. The selection of cabinet materials is based on physical data and audibility tests. Multi-layer particleboards are used for the five sides except for the back, and Canadian douglas fur with excellent damping characteristics is used for the back plate. In addition, the use of a dispersion type reinforcing bar prevents resonance from concentrating and provides natural attenuation characteristics. The DS 303 is designed to determine how much power should be used to drive an amplifier when listening to music. In order to ensure a sound level of 100 dB (instantaneous value) in stereo reproduction in a large listening room of 12 to 16 tatami mats, an input resistance of 100W is required for efficiency, and an output power of at least 40W is required in order to satisfy the conditions in a small room of 4.5 or 6 tatami mats. For this reason, it was recommended that the DS 303 be driven by an amplifier with an output of approximately 40W to 100W.(See graph below on listening level and distance from speaker system)"

name: DS-401
description:
## Description

"A high-quality bookshelf speaker system that uses honeycomb cones.

WOOFER
A 30 cm cone type woofer using honeycomb cone is mounted in the low range. The honeycomb cone consists of a honeycomb-shaped honeycomb core made of thin aluminum foil sandwiched between thin glass fiber reinforced plastics (GFRP) films on both sides. For this reason, the air layer occupies nearly 90% of the entire diaphragm, and it is light and highly rigid. In particular, the weight-to-strength ratio and weight-to-rigidity ratio are extremely large compared to other diaphragms, and the strain generated from the piston vibration region is greatly reduced. In addition, the honeycomb cone has an appropriate internal loss by sticking a foam damping sheet on the back side of the diaphragm, and the generation of natural vibration is suppressed. The lowest resonance frequency of the DS 401 is set at 37 Hz, which is combined with a low-distortion magnetic circuit to increase the reproduction capability of heavy bass. The low distortion magnetic circuit adopted in the DS-35B is used for the magnetic circuit. In this magnetic circuit, a special magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics developed by a metallurgical engineering approach is installed in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap, and the non-linear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit is reduced to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to the conventional one.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. This unit is made as light as possible by adding fundamental consideration to the material of the cone paper. In addition, by applying moderate braking to the center cap, incidental noise which was thought to be difficult to control is eliminated. In addition, it is molded to be strong to match the air suspension system well.

WOOFER
A low-distortion magnetic circuit is used for the magnetic circuit like the woofer, and a die-cast frame is used for the frame to further reduce distortion.

TWEETER
A newly designed 4 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. The diaphragm is made of Konica Le Dome GFRP, and the piston vibration range is extended to achieve smooth frequency characteristics up to the high end.

NETWORK
By adopting new technology in the network section, distortion is reduced.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition to pursuing physical characteristics by strictly checking the materials of coils, capacitors, and resistors, as well as the winding and circuit configuration, hearing tests have been conducted to an extent that is audibly satisfactory. As a result, we have adopted a core coil for the coil to improve damping, a metallized polyester film capacitor for the capacitor, and a well-examined cement resistor for the level adjustment resistor. This low-distortion network circuit realizes clear playback sound in the entire playback band from the heavy low range to the super high range. It is equipped with 4-position switching type level control for the middle and high frequency ranges respectively. The front baffle has a symmetrical vertical single row unit configuration with a squaker and a tweeter positioned slightly inward from the center line to improve sound image localization. The enclosure employs an air suspension system, which brakes the cone paper by suppressing the air in the enclosed enclosure.

ENCLOSURE
In addition, by adopting a dispersion resonance type enclosure with a strong joint structure and special dispersion type reinforcing beam, the resonance mode is dispersed and the box ringing phenomenon is suppressed. The exterior features a natural walnut veneer finish."

description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier with all-silicon transistor configuration.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a quasi complimentary service SEPPP OTL circuit. A 4-series volume is used for the volume, and it is changed at both the input and output sides of the preamplifier. This prevents the S / N ratio from deteriorating at low volume. A 3-stage direct connection amplifier is used for the preamplifier section.

description:
## Description

"Diatone is the first receiver released at the same time as the pre-main amplifier DA-55U. The amplifier uses the complimentary service SEPP-OTL system with all-silicon transistors. The power transistor is a diffused silicon transistor with high resistance to secondary breakdown. It is designed to withstand a small amount of output short-circuit even if the speaker terminal is short-circuited by mistake. The AM tuner section is equipped with a ferrite bar antenna. The tone control uses 7-step 3-dB switching tone control. With this method, there is no deviation between channels, and accurate tone adjustment is possible.

CABINET
The exterior uses a wooden cabinet made of Eurasian teak material, which is the same design as that of the commercial Diatone speaker announced at the same time."
