name: DA-U10AV
description:
## Description

"An AV amplifier designed for surround sound but with a focus on CD playback. Equipped with a super-dynamic delay line circuit, the dynamic range is improved by 30 to 40 dB compared with conventional analog delay circuits, and a dynamic range of 90 dB or more, comparable to that of digital delay systems, is secured.

MOTOR
Multi-feedback servo system is used for the feedback circuit of the amplifier section. In this system, the servo circuit consists of two systems, a main loop for controlling the music signal and a servo loop for increasing stability in the ultra-low frequency range. This improves the resolution of the amplifier and the low-frequency drive capability. Using a differential charge method, the surround signal output from the rear amplifier is supplied with opposite phases between the left and right channels. This averages the supply state and increases the power capacity of the rear amplifier to a maximum of 2 times. In addition, the instantaneous current supply capability is greatly improved to improve the drive capability of the speakers.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section is equipped with a 4-channel power amplifier in which the front and rear power amplifiers are completely independent circuits. Audio condensers, large-capacity power cords, and pattern design studies have been conducted to improve sound quality. "A control amplifier paired with the DA-A100. The base potential of the first stage transistor is made equal to the ground potential by the adoption of the irregular 2 power supply (+ 75 V, -12V) so that the leakage current of the coupling capacitor is eliminated. The amplifier circuits for monitoring and line out are designed to withstand especially low load impedance (over 100 �) and long distance wiring (200m with shielded cable)."

name: M-P01
description:
## Description

"A small preamplifier of discrete configuration realized by a push switch and 4-layered printed circuit board. Built-in MC head amplifier with new type transistor adopted for DA-P15 type. In the first stage of the equalizer amplifier and tone amplifier, we use a low-noise FET that is carefully selected in terms of noise and performance in order to minimize the noise generated by the transistor. In addition, we increase the S/N ratio by reducing the impedance of the feedback circuit. Also, in terms of circuit, we have adopted a differential 2-stage amplifier circuit + class A push-pull circuit with a current mirror load with less distortion. This circuit reduces distortion in open loop and improves bare characteristics such as a wider band. This enables stable negative feedback and low distortion factor. Equipped with digital tone control by fixed resistor and push switch. Accurate tone control can be achieved in 2 dB steps by selecting plus or minus and the amount of change with the push switch. Note that the CR time constant circuit of the tone control circuit creates undulations in the frequency response even at the tone control flat position. Therefore, the M-P01 has a tone defeat switch, so that the time constant circuit is completely disconnected when the switch is turned on to obtain a flat frequency response.

POWER SUPPLY
A large-capacity power supply is used for the power supply section, and DC voltage is supplied to each unit amplifier through a constant voltage circuit, enabling stable operation of each unit amplifier. Tape duplication allows you to listen to other sources while the tape is being copied. Equipped with a subsonic filter. Built-in muting relay prevents click noise when the power is ON. The phono input terminal is gold-plated to prevent changes over time."

name: DA-P7000
description:
## Description

"A reference AV preamplifier with separate video and audio components. The DA-P7000 uses an AV separate structure in which the video selector and audio circuits are housed in separate housings to eliminate interference such as noise. The control signal is supplied from the audio section to the video section via a power line with an independent video winding transformer and a photocoupler. From this signal line, only the minimum required current and the signal for controlling the video selector are sent. Thus, the audio and video sections are completely isolated. The video amplifier section uses a discrete configuration using a wide-band high-frequency transistor. Combined with the use of a video-only switch, it realizes a wide bandwidth of 20 MHz. All selector circuits are equipped with a dedicated video bipolar switch IC. Since the bipolar switch consists of an emitter follower with low-output impedance and broadband characteristics, it provides excellent switching performance for video signals. In order to prevent Y and C signals from interfering with each other, we have adopted a three dimensional board structure in which only the Y signal selector part of the signal processing circuit is composed of another board, and this board is made to stand upright on the C signal selector board so as to have the shortest wiring distance. As a result, the Y signal and C signal are arranged at the shortest distance without crossing each other, and various characteristics are improved. Y/C isolation circuit expert DCF is installed. This circuit calculates the vertical and horizontal uncorrelated energy of video signals on a pixel-by-pixel basis and selects three types of optimal filters (BPF). It is an IC-based circuit that uses a horizontal band-pass filter (1-D) when the horizontal correlation is strong, a vertical band-pass filter (2-D) when the vertical correlation is strong, and an oblique band-pass filter (1-D + 2-D) when neither is strong. This greatly reduces both horizontal and vertical dot interference and color fading compared to conventional products.

POWER SUPPLY
The video circuit has a two power supply configuration similar to the audio circuit.

POWER SUPPLY
By separating the power supply circuit from the ground circuit, the inflow of unnecessary circuit current into the ground circuit is greatly reduced and high S/N is achieved. In addition, the input-output coupling capacitor can be removed, resulting in higher picture quality. Full digital audio signal processing is used in the audio section, so that analog input signals are converted into digital signals by an A/D converter and processed as digital signals until they are finally converted into analog signals and output. The D/A converter uses a newly developed variable current discrete 1-bit DAC that brings out the original merits of the 1-bit type. This DA converter drives an electronic switch at a constant current so that the circuit is not affected by power supply fluctuations. It also uses a constant current type PWM method to eliminate power supply voltage fluctuations by making the load current of the power supply constant. The differential amplifier and current / voltage conversion circuit use an audio OP amplifier (manufactured by PMI Inc. of the United States) with excellent power supply fluctuation rejection capability. DC servo is applied to eliminate coupling capacitors. This eliminates AM modulation distortion and maximizes linearity. Digital volume is used for the volume circuit. This volume has a structure in which the current value of the constant current source of the differential switch can be changed by the volume control circuit, and the rotation of the knob is detected by the rotary encoder linked to the volume knob, so that bit dropping does not occur at any volume value from 0 dB to -72dB. To eliminate jitter and prevent degradation of sound quality, a jitter-free digital sound collector is used in the jitter elimination circuit. This circuit has a dual PLL configuration consisting of two 1st and 2nd PLL circuits. The 2nd PLL uses a newly developed wide-band lithium tantalate oscillator with frequency accuracy and stability comparable to those of quartz crystal, and with a frequency variable width of more than three times that of conventional ones and ¥3,000 ppm or more. The digital input signal is first demodulated by a clock generated by the 1st PLL, and the data is written into a memory buffer of three words by a dedicated IC. The 2nd PLL resynchronizes the clock of the 1st PLL to generate a high-precision clock with less jitter. This clock is used to read the data written into the buffer and eliminate jitter. In addition, if the response of the PLL circuit is fast, the oscillator in the loop will follow the jitter and create a clock with a lot of jitter. Therefore, the slower the response of the 2nd PLL, the better the jitter removal effect. However, if the response is too slow, the lock will be released easily and the sound will be cut off. Therefore, by changing the response of the 2nd PLL to two speed automatic transmission and switching between fast and slow speed depending on the situation, stable lock is secured and the ultra-slow response of the PLL is achieved.

POWER SUPPLY
An independent shunt regulator is applied to the power supply of the PLL circuit for each block to suppress the generation of jitter caused by the inflow of power supply noise. An ID interface is used to prevent the deterioration of sound quality caused by noise generated during transmission of digital audio signals that have undergone surround processing and other processing by DSP. The ID interface is structured to transmit not the digital signal itself information contained in the signal, not the digital signal itself. It consists of two C-MOS FET analog switches, which are connected to the power supply when one is ON and to the ground when the other is ON. Both the power supply and the ground are kept clean with little noise. The digital audio signal is not directly input to the D/A converter, but when it is used as an open / close signal for two analog switches, the switch on the power supply side is ON when the signal is HIGH, and the switch on the ground side is ON when the signal is LOW. Thus, the high-low relationship of the newly created digital signal corresponds to the input signal, but the uncorrelated noise of the digital audio signal is shut out and clean D/A conversion is realized. In addition to Dolby Pro Logic, MHT Logic and Mono Logic are available as surround modes. MHT Logic is Mitsubishi's original surround mode that supports Dolby Surround encoded software. Sound field effects are fully digitally processed by DSP, and associated bit loss is handled by all-channel noise shaping to achieve high-quality surround playback. The center mode can be selected from REAL mode and VIRTUAL mode. The REAL mode is set when the center speaker is used. The entire band from low to high is output to the center speaker. The VIRTUAL mode is set when the center speaker is not used. The two LR2 speakers direct speech to the center using a directional enhancement circuit. Furthermore, by adjusting the arrival time of the center channel signal with the C (CENTER) PRESENCE function, it is possible to improve the center orientation. With the MULTI DELAY function, you can use two to four rear speakers to create a surround sound field similar to a room with six to twelve rear speakers. You can adjust the size of the sound field by switching between modes. With REAR DELAY you can adjust the DELAY time of the rear speaker. With the REAR FILTER you can adjust the cutoff characteristics of a low-pass filter that cuts out the high-frequency range of the rear-channel signal, usually set to 7 kHz, to 9 kHz for more sound, or to 4 kHz for a milder sound. With the THEATER LPF, you can adjust recorded sources for movie theater playback with high-frequency enhancements.

HEADS
With the AZIMUTH function, if the angle (azimuth) of the playback head is out of alignment with the recording head during the process of creating the software, you can adjust the offset of the azimuth of the software. With the AUTO INPUT function, you can improve the situation in which speech sounds like dialogue from the center are heard through speakers other than the center channel. Equipped with a subwoofer output. Digital processing of the low-pass filter enables three levels of switching between 40 Hz, 63 Hz and 80 Hz according to the characteristics. Cutoff characteristic is 24dB/oct. In Mono Logic mode, you can add surround sound to monaural recorded video and LD software. It is equipped with an on-screen function that enables you to adjust the surround sound mode and dub processing while checking the screen. There are three types of displays : the main screen for selecting the input / output source and surround type, the sub screen for determining the volume of each speaker and whether the subwoofer is ON/OFF, and the REC monitor screen for checking the recording status. In addition to superimposing, it can also be displayed on blueback Antilope cervicapra. It is equipped with the ambisonic surround system licensed by Nimbus Records UK. This surround system provides surround sound for normal stereo sources, but it is especially effective for four channel ambisonic-encoded software. Comes with a wireless remote control with a lighting function that lights up when the button is pressed. This remote control is equipped with an auto-function function that enables you to perform a series of operations with the touch of a button in a system composed of Mitsubishi AV devices that support auto-function. It is also equipped with a learning function that enables you to learn and operate the remote control functions of other AV devices."

name: M-A01
description:
## Description

"A compact stereo power amplifier that maintains high performance.

POWER SUPPLY
In order to improve low-frequency phase distortion and transient cross-modulation distortion, we have adopted DC without any capacitor, which is the time constant of the circuit, thereby realizing flat characteristics up to the DC range. A RET (Ring Emitter Transistor) is used for the power transistor in order to improve the elongation of the high-frequency range. In addition, the gain before applying negative feedback is optimally distributed to each stage to improve the bare characteristics, making it easier to apply stable negative feedback to high frequencies. Specifically, we propose distortion by reducing the negative feedback at low frequencies and increasing the negative feedback at high frequencies. In the first stage, a unique low-noise dual FET with uniform characteristics, high gm (mutual inductance) and extremely low noise is adopted, which improves the S/N ratio. The power supply consists of two 55V/20,000 Ï‰ F filter capacitors and a 250 va power transformer with a highly efficient and compact cut core. This power supply occupies approximately 40% of the volume inside the amplifier and is small but has a strong power supply. It is equipped with peak level indicator by 12 LED display of one channel.

POWER SUPPLY
In order to reduce the size, the power supply circuits other than the power transformer and heat sink are integrated on a single printed circuit board. In addition, attention is paid to the coupling of magnetic flux generated by the large power supply. In order to eliminate the coupling of magnetic flux between input and output, detailed consideration is also given to the arrangement of parts of input and output circuits and the routing of copper foil patterns. In addition, with regard to the problem that the copper foil pattern becomes narrow by reducing the size of the printed circuit board and affects the impedance of the pattern, we have widened the copper foil pattern in proportion to the magnitude of the current to reduce the effect of the pattern impedance. The heat sink is exposed on the right and left sides, and air is taken in from the lower part of the front panel, and convection is generated inside the set to ensure thermal stability that can withstand large output. Independent protection circuits are mounted on the speaker side and amplifier side respectively."

name: DS-66Z
description:
## Description

"This bass reflex speaker system is a condensation of Diatone technology. It is equipped with 27 cm cone type woofer which uses for the low range.

WOOFER
The New Aramid Hybrid Cone is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm is made of aramid hybrid FRP with an intra-ply structure of aramid organic fiber aramid, which has high rigidity and an appropriate loss factor, and inorganic fiber amorphous silica, which has high strength. The DS-66Z has 15% higher strength of amorphous silica than the conventional one and is woven into the hybrid structure to achieve both higher specific elastic modulus and appropriate internal loss. The frame is a strong R. S. frame that is firmly mounted in the enclosure.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker. The cone section of the diaphragm is a New Aramid Hybrid Cone similar to the Woofer diaphragm, and the center diaphragm section is a newly developed Omega Titanium Dome with high specific elastic modulus and internal loss. A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. The diaphragm is made of boron, which has excellent characteristics such as high-speed response to input signals and suppression of noise inherent in metal materials. By integrating the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin into a D. U. D structure, the driving force generated in the voice coil is transmitted to the diaphragm without loss. This improves transient response, high upper limit frequency, linearity, and input resistance. In addition, the D. M. system of hybrid structure is adopted for the unit structure, and the whole plate is mounted attenuate the natural resonance of the magnetic circuit itself. It is a magnetic shielding design, and the screen is not adversely affected even on the side of the cathode ray tube. A crimping wiring method is used for connection of the network. Wires are passed through a sleeve and then crimped and crimped to eliminate the strain at the boundary between dissimilar metals caused by soldering.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, in order to reduce power supply loss due to the wiring system, the wiring after the input terminal is independent for each unit, and the wiring from the input terminal to each unit is connected by a one point concentrated crimping method to ensure a well-balanced current supply. In addition, laminated oriented cores are used for coils, oxygen-free copper wires are used for electrical wires, and capacitors and resistors are carefully selected after repeated measurements and listening tests. A two sided round baffle enclosure with a round shape on both sides of the front baffle prevents diffraction of sound waves. In addition, Diatone's unique computer analysis technology such as modal analysis is utilized in the design of the enclosure to realize a highly rigid distributed resonant enclosure. There was a special speaker stand sold separately."

description:

description:
## Description

"This is a speaker system that fully incorporates the technical ideas cultivated in the 2S 3003 and pursues high musicality as pure audio and high-fidelity monitor-oriented playback. A 27 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The diaphragm woven aramid honeycomb cone is used for the diaphragm.

WOOFER
Aramid fiber satisfies high strength, excellent vibration damping characteristics, and light weight as diaphragm material in high dimension. This material is used as skin material of 3-axis woven aramid which demonstrates strength in all directions, and honeycomb structure of vibration damping aluminum alloy core is used. TWEETER

NETWORK
The network section uses a Through-the-Network connection for the woofer circuit. The input terminal is directly connected to the woofer by taking advantage of the high roll-off characteristic of the woofer. This realizes a high-quality sound field and sound image localization. The enclosure has a shoulder round structure. The shape of the DS-A1 is based on the rich sound of a stringed instrument. In the DS-A1, large members of high-density Canadian Maple Solid are used to round the both shoulders. This structure increases strength by reducing the area of the top plate and disperses vibration modes by dividing the joint. The bass reflex port uses laminated high-density particleboards, which are hollowed out to an optimum shape to ensure high rigidity and suppress unnecessary resonance. The rear terminal is set directly on the cabinet base to avoid complication of vibration mode due to unnecessary processing. In addition, terminals compatible with banana plugs are used."

name: DIATONEF1
description:
## Description

"This is a bookshelf type speaker system using the newly developed bass reflex method.

CABINET
ENCLOSURE
A bass reflex system is used for the enclosure, and a newly developed underwater center duct is used for the bass reflex port. In a 2-way system, there are two causes of cross modulation distortion : one is that the high sound emitted from the tweeter hits the diaphragm of the woofer and the high sound modulated by the vibration of the diaphragm is radiated, and the other is that the vibration of the woofer is transmitted through the baffle plate and causes the tweeter to swing by the vibration and cross modulation distortion is generated. In order to reduce the cross modulation distortion caused by these causes, the extrinsic center duct adopted in F1 has a bass reflex duct installed between the woofer and the tweeter, and the opening of the duct protrudes from the baffle plate. This structure prevents the sound emitted from the tweeter from reaching the woofer by blocking the duct, and at the same time prevents the vibration transmitted from the woofer to the baffle plate from being transmitted to the tweeter, thus reducing the cross modulation distortion.

WOOFER
A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The cone paper is equipped with an effective corrugation, material, molding method, and additives to prevent distortion due to split vibration. The sound quality is also improved by a powerful magnetic circuit and a die-cast frame weighing approximately 1.4 kg.

TWEETER
A 5 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. A semi-dome type with a wide frequency range is adopted in order to reproduce the middle and high frequencies well. In addition, by increasing the voice coil diameter, generation of distortion is suppressed and transient is improved."

name: DP-105
description:
## Description

"A CD player with technologies such as 3-beam laser pickups and servo circuit LSIs. Equipped with Diatone's original 3-beam system laser pickup. In this method, the laser light emitted from a semiconductor laser is first divided by a grating plate into a light for reading signals and a left and right laser light for tracking servo. The left and right reflected lights have the same output, but if there is even a slight difference between them, there will be a difference in brightness between the two. This allows us to catch tracking errors and control the signal detection beam so that it always follows each pit line. It is equipped with a focus servo that optically detects the coupling state on the photodiode by the combination of a converging lens and a cylindrical lens. In this servo circuit, if the image of the laser beam connected to the photodiode is a true circle, the focus is judged to be normal, and if it is an ellipse, it is judged to be a focus error. Based on this, the up-and-down motion of the rotating disk is detected, and the pickup is controlled so that the signal detection laser beam from the objective lens reaches an accurate end point on the disk. It adopts a unique tracking mechanism using a rotary mirror. In addition, the use of special rubber material eliminates vibration noise during high-speed search. In order to obtain sufficient resolution and aberration, the objective lens is mounted with a machining accuracy of less than 1 / 2 of the laser wavelength. In response to the focus error signal from the servo circuit, the objective lens is moved at high speed by the change of magnetic flux density. In addition, the suspension has been removed in order to eliminate resonance noise during driving. We have developed and installed special LSIs for servo circuits such as tracking servo, focus servo and pickup feed servo. A one chip microcomputer is used for the circuit that processes the sequence control commands. The D/A converter is equipped with an integrating D/A converter with 16-bit accuracy. The analog filter after D/A conversion uses a Chebyshev type low-pass filter with a unique circuit configuration. No lead wires are used in the signal circuit from the D/A converter to the line output terminal. Moreover, the output terminal is directly mounted on the printed circuit board. This reduces signal transmission loss and eliminates degradation of high frequency characteristics and noise generation. The printed circuit board has been designed with an optimum pattern to improve channel separation.

POWER SUPPLY
An independent DC stabilizing power supply circuit is installed in the analog amplifier section to prevent noise generated from the digital system and servo circuit from adversely affecting the analog circuit. It is equipped with a random program of up to 30 songs, a cue in the index display and a 4-mode repeat function."

name: D-102
description:
## Description

"A digital audio processor that enables you to enjoy digital audio from a video cassette by simply connecting to a home video deck. The D-102 is equipped with a non-feedback active filter that is also used in the D-1, the first EIAJ digital audio processor announced in 1979. In addition, the D-102 has improved this non-feedback active filter by selecting a capacitor and reducing its size to improve sound quality. A newly developed simple deglitch circuit is used in the deglitch circuit that eliminates the glitch signal generated during D/A conversion in the playback mode. This circuit reduces the degradation of the mid - and high-frequency range caused by the CR integration circuit and high-speed operational amplifier that occurs in circuits composed of conventional analog switches, CR integration circuits, and high-speed operational amplifiers.

POWER SUPPLY
The parts used for analog circuits and power supply circuits are carefully selected. Only tantalum-based resistors are used. Capacitors are based on electrolytic acoustic capacitors with the best energy balance, and copper foil styrene capacitors, acoustic film capacitors, etc. are used according to the operation and function of each circuit part. In addition, pure copper and copper-plated products are used for the housing, screws, wiring materials, etc., and only those with the best balance of characteristics are used, such as the adoption of low-feedback capacitance operational amplifier.

POWER SUPPLY
By reducing the power consumption of the digital circuit itself, improved sound quality and built-in power supply circuit have been realized. The D-102 uses a C-MOS type, which has the advantage of low power consumption compared with the conventional N-MOS type, when the digital circuit is integrated into an LSI. It also uses a C-MOS type for a 16k-SRAM for wow and flutter removal and an 8-bit 1-chip microcomputer. This realizes low power consumption of 0.5W or less, while the power consumption of the N-MOS type is 3-4W.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply is equipped with a Current Controlled Voltage Regulator (CCVR) power supply circuit developed based on the basic concept of ""a power supply circuit suitable for digital audio."" This improves the SN ratio of the power supply output by approximately 30 dB and does not use any capacitor in the power supply line. Equipped with an auto fade-in / fade-out function using a digital fader circuit."

name: DA-Q100
description:
## Description

"This is a 4-ch decoder dedicated to components with an SE logic circuit mounted on the decoder section that contains three types of matrices (RM, SQ, and QM-4), which dramatically increases the separation degree of the matrix 4 ch. The SE logic circuit is used to improve the crosstalk problem of the matrix 4 ch. This circuit uses the main signal to create a negative-phase signal, eliminating and suppressing only the crosstalk components that leak into each channel, and achieves discrete-like separation. This logic circuit is based on the principle of the logic circuit. First, a comparison detection circuit detects the magnitude of the signal between the opposite channels and converts it into a DC control signal. This signal is sent to a gain control circuit (gain control), and the main signal is controlled to become an erase signal with phases opposite to each other of 0 � and 180 �. Then, the main signal (the output of the matrix) and the erase signal are mixed by an addition circuit, and the crosstalk component is eliminated. This structure ensures distortion-free sound quality unlike AGC, which directly controls the gain of the main signal, because the main signal is adjusted without any modification. The decoder has built-in RM (Regular Matrix), SQ and QM-4 matrix, and is designed for wide adaptability to 4 ch playback. As a result, most commercially available records can be played in 4 ch by switching the switch. The CD-4 system can also be used as a 4-ch control center by installing a demodulator connection terminal. Equipped with terminals for discretes, you can enjoy discretes just by connecting a tape deck. It uses 4 large level meters of front and rear."

name: 4S-4002
description:
## Description

"Large 4-way monitor speaker. The 4S 4002 was developed to cope with the improvement of program source performance by adoption of direct cutting and PCM deck. The main targets are wide-band wide-band playback from 20 Hz to 30 kHz and low distortion of -50dB or less. In addition, improvements in phase characteristics, which have a significant effect on sound quality, and input resistance, which is required as the basic performance of professional speakers, are also being sought. Based on this speaker, the 4S-4002P was developed and sold since 1977.

WOOFER
A high-rigidity diaphragm using a honeycomb sandwich cone is adopted for the diaphragm in the middle and low frequency range, and reproduction characteristics which uniformly extend to 20 Hz in 2 � space are obtained. In addition, the magnetic circuit is made of permalloy to reduce current distortion, thereby realizing a lower distortion than ever before. In addition, the voice coil is made of newly developed heat-resistant epoxy imide adhesive to improve input resistance.40 cm cone type woofer and 40 cm cone type passive radiator are mounted for low range.

MIDRANGE
The mid-range is equipped with 18 cm cone mid-range.

TWEETER
A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range, and a 2.3 cm dome type super tweeter is installed in the ultra high range. These units are equipped with a protective circuit to protect against excessive input and contribute to improved input resistance.

NETWORK
In order to improve the phase characteristics in the network section, a phase correction circuit is installed in the units above the mid-range. The network configuration is designed to allow switching between multi-amplifier mode and full-range mode. At the top of the rear of the enclosure there was space for the driver amplifier."

name: 4S-4002P
description:
## Description

"This large-size monitor speaker system was developed in 1977 (1977) to meet the performance improvement of program sources such as direct cutting records and PCM decks. It has a 40 cm cone woofer in the low range and an 18 cm cone midrange in the middle range.

WOOFER
A honeycomb construction (HC) cone, which is light and has high bending strength, is used for the vibration plate of these units to reduce the strain of the vibration system. In addition, a special magnetic alloy is used for the magnetic circuit to reduce the current strain thereby realizing a lower strain than ever before. A 40 cm cone type passive radiator is installed for the low frequency band to enhance the low sound reproduction capability.

TWEETER
A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range, and a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the ultra high range. Newly developed heat-resistant adhesive is used for the voice coil of each unit.

NETWORK
The network section focuses on the phase between the speakers, which is important in a multi-way speaker system, and uses a phase shifting circuit to improve the sound connection between the units. In addition, a protective circuit ensures high reliability. The enclosure uses a V-shaped reinforcement to reduce vibration and suppress box rumbling. Honeycomb cones are used for bass and middle sound units. Ultra-bass sound can be reproduced with large capacity and low distortion."
